info.title: CF Meet Platform — Developer Console API
info.description: The Developer Console of the CF Meet Platform: the control plane where a partner manages its workspaces, projects, environments, service accounts, API keys, scopes, webhooks, usage, limits and production access. (A workspace is called an organization in paths and fields: /v1/organizations, organizationId.) The partner's product traffic (meetings, messaging, calling) goes to the domain APIs of the same gateway, not here. Section 50 developer / enterprise control plane, served through the public API Gateway. Human console operations use the verified CF Meet session (verified by the Meeting Service through the session bridge); server automation uses scoped Platform Access credentials where noted. Organizations, projects and environments are Developer Platform metadata over canonical Platform Access tenants, applications and environments: Platform Access remains the only identity, credential and scope authority. Non-members get NOT_FOUND for another tenant's resources. Every response carries X-Request-Id. Section 53 central webhooks: the Developer Console manages an environment's webhook subscriptions, delivery and attempt history and replays under /v1/environments/{environmentId}/webhooks* and /webhook-deliveries/*. The machine-credential webhook API keeps Calling's public contract and paths (cfmeet.calling.http-api /v1/webhooks*); the API Gateway re-points it to the Developer Platform at the cut-over (cfmeet.developer-platform.internal-api documents the served routes). Section 50 service accounts: OWNER / ADMIN create, suspend and resume an environment's Platform Access service accounts under /v1/environments/{environmentId}/service-accounts* (delegated to Platform Access, the only store; DEVELOPER reads; machine credentials need `service_accounts.manage`); API credentials stay Section 54. 1.4.0 (Part VI Chapters 10–13): Section 54 credential self-service (create with the secret once, list, read, rotate with bounded overlap, revoke, suspend / resume, quota restrictions), the scope registry and project scope grants, the organization credential policy; Section 55 production-access requests (submit, read, cancel, activate) and status, environment usage (rollups, facts, CSV / JSON export, warnings) and limits; Section 57 support profiles. 1.5.0 (Part VI Chapters 14–18): activity filters (`projectId`, `action`) and cursor pagination of credentials and production-access requests. 1.7.0 (ADR 0062 / 0063, CF Meet Platform Build): the partner Users API for machine credentials (/v1/users*, delegated to Platform Access; principals.read / principals.write / user_tokens.issue; user tokens returned once), the console user list and SANDBOX test token generator, allowed websites (/v1/environments/{environmentId}/allowed-origins) and push credentials (/v1/environments/{environmentId}/push-credentials*, secrets sealed to the Notification Service, metadata only), each behind its own default-off flag; LIMIT_EXCEEDED for the optional workspace / project creation caps. 1.8.0 (ADR 0064 / 0065, CF Meet Apps): app registration on projects (/v1/projects/{projectId}/app*: immutable manifest versions, client secret shown once, review submission, grants, draft test accounts; OWNER / ADMIN; flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APPS_ENABLED), the anonymous OAuth endpoints /v1/oauth/token, /revoke, /userinfo, /metadata (RFC 6749 wire format, relayed to Platform Access; flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_OAUTH_ENABLED) and the anonymous app directory /v1/app-directory* (PUBLISHED, PUBLIC apps; flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APP_DIRECTORY_ENABLED).

tags.name: Organizations
tags.description: Workspaces (paths and fields: organizations): a partner's API customer account, backed by an EXTERNAL Platform Access tenant; ownership transfer and closure. Not CF Meet business organizations (/api/v2/organizations).

tags.name: Members
tags.description: Human members of a workspace and their roles (OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER, ANALYST, BILLING).

tags.name: Invitations
tags.description: Invitations to join a workspace.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Projects (Platform Access applications) of a workspace.

tags.name: Environments
tags.description: Environments of a project.

tags.name: Service accounts
tags.description: Platform Access machine identities of an environment, delegated to Platform Access; never a credential.

tags.name: Credentials
tags.description: Credential metadata, issuance, rotation and revocation for service accounts.

tags.name: Scopes
tags.description: The scope registry and the scopes granted to a project.

tags.name: Production access
tags.description: Requests for production access and their review history.

tags.name: Commercial
tags.description: Commercial plans, plan assignments and billing-account references.

tags.name: Usage
tags.description: Usage facts and summaries.

tags.name: Limits
tags.description: Effective limits and limit warnings.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Developer Console webhook subscriptions, signing secret rotation, deliveries and replay.

tags.name: Activity
tags.description: Immutable activity history of a workspace.

tags.name: Support
tags.description: Support profiles and incident status.

tags.name: Partner users
tags.description: ADR 0062: partner users (Platform Access principals of an environment) and CF Meet user tokens, the device login of partner apps; the console's user list and SANDBOX token generator.

tags.name: Allowed websites
tags.description: ADR 0062: an environment's allowed websites (exact origins) for browser device logins.

tags.name: Push credentials
tags.description: ADR 0063: partner APNs / FCM push credentials, sealed to the Notification Service (metadata only here).

tags.name: Apps
tags.description: ADR 0064 / 0065: the app registered on a project (manifest versions, client secret, review submission, grants, test accounts).

tags.name: OAuth
tags.description: ADR 0064: the public OAuth 2.0 endpoints of CF Meet Apps (anonymous; RFC 6749 / 7009 / 8414 wire format).

tags.name: App directory
tags.description: ADR 0065: the public directory of PUBLISHED, PUBLIC apps (anonymous).

parameters.description: The subscription version the change is based on (stale: 409 VERSION_CONFLICT).

post.description: Issue or rotate the app's client secret (returned once; the previous secret keeps Platform Access's 24 h overlap). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Human console session only (machine credentials are refused). Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APPS_ENABLED.

post.summary: Submit the current version for review (DRAFT / REJECTED, or an APPROVED / PUBLISHED app with pending changes; no loopback redirect; PUBLIC apps name privacy policy and terms)
post.description: Submit the current version for review (DRAFT / REJECTED, or an APPROVED / PUBLISHED app with pending changes; no loopback redirect; PUBLIC apps name privacy policy and terms). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Human console session only (machine credentials are refused). Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APPS_ENABLED.

get.summary: List the app's installations (from Platform Access; no CF Meet account id)
get.description: List the app's installations (from Platform Access; no CF Meet account id). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Human console session only (machine credentials are refused). Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APPS_ENABLED.

put.summary: Replace the draft test accounts (CF Meet account ids, at most 25, format checked only)
put.description: Replace the draft test accounts (CF Meet account ids, at most 25, format checked only). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Human console session only (machine credentials are refused). Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APPS_ENABLED.

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code (PKCE S256) or a refresh token for tokens
post.description: RFC 6749 token endpoint. Anonymous at the API Gateway: the client authenticates with its client secret (client_secret_basic or client_secret_post) and Platform Access verifies it; refresh tokens rotate and a reused code or superseded refresh token revokes the whole installation. Responses are snake_case with Cache-Control: no-store. Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_OAUTH_ENABLED.

post.summary: Revoke an access or refresh token (RFC 7009)
post.description: RFC 7009 revocation: 200 whatever the token's state, 401 invalid_client when client authentication fails. Anonymous at the API Gateway; same client authentication as the token endpoint. Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_OAUTH_ENABLED.

get.summary: Read the signed-in user's profile with a user access token
get.description: Bearer cfoa_ user access token with profile:read (email only with profile:email). Anonymous at the API Gateway: Platform Access introspects the token, the Meeting Service supplies the profile; sub is pairwise per app. Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_OAUTH_ENABLED.

get.summary: Read the OAuth authorization server metadata
get.description: RFC 8414-style metadata: the authorization endpoint (the CF Meet consent page), token, revocation and userinfo endpoints, scopes, PKCE S256, the code response type and both grant types. Anonymous. Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_OAUTH_ENABLED.

get.summary: List the published public apps
get.description: The app directory: PUBLISHED, PUBLIC, not suspended apps with their published manifest (name, description, logo, developer, scopes, privacy and terms URLs, whether they have an in-meeting surface). Anonymous. Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APP_DIRECTORY_ENABLED.

get.summary: Read one published public app
get.description: One directory entry (anything not PUBLISHED, PUBLIC and live is 404). Anonymous. Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APP_DIRECTORY_ENABLED.

userSession.description: The signed-in developer's CF Meet session (Developer Console). Never a machine credential.

platformCredential.description: A Platform Access API credential (server-side only; never in a browser).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Replays return the original response; reuse with a different request is IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. One-time secrets are never replayed.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when the response is the stored result of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key (no new effect).

platform-developer.common.v1.Error.description: Error envelope (Cache-Control: no-store). Messages never contain an identifier, credential, token or database text.

summary.description: Safe change summary: opaque ids, codes and display metadata only — never secrets, credentials, contacts or E2EE material.

platform-developer.control.v1.ActivityLi.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

platform-developer.control.v1.AllowedOri.description: ADR 0062: an environment's allowed websites (exact origins).

apnsHost.description: SANDBOX and TEST environments may only use SANDBOX.

p8.description: The APNs token signing key (.p8, PEM). Write-only.

platform-developer.control.v1.App.description: ADR 0064 / 0065: the app registered on a project (clientId = projectId = the Platform Access application id). The live version is what Platform Access serves: the published version, else the approved one, else the current draft.

platform-developer.control.v1.AppClientS.description: ADR 0064: a new client secret, returned ONCE (an idempotent replay returns clientSecretRedacted instead).

platform-developer.control.v1.AppGrant.description: ADR 0064: an installation of the app (never a CF Meet account id).

platform-developer.control.v1.AppManifes.description: ADR 0064: an app manifest (normalized; every change is a new immutable version).

platform-developer.control.v1.BillingAcc.description: Billing-account REFERENCE metadata. Never card, bank, charge or balance data.

platform-developer.control.v1.Commercial.description: An immutable commercial plan version. No price exists in Part VI.
A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

externalId.description: The partner's opaque user id (printable ASCII, no spaces); never a phone number, tel: / sip: URI.

kind.description: PRODUCTION environments are activated by the production-access workflow (Section 55).

platform-developer.control.v1.CreatePush.description: Uploads (replaces) the environment's credential of that provider (APNS with voip false / true, or FCM).

name.description: Stable key: 1-63 lowercase letters, digits or '-', starting with a letter or digit; unique within the environment.

platform-developer.control.v1.CreateServ.description: Creates a service account in a SANDBOX / TEST environment (PRODUCTION is refused: production-access workflow). No credential is issued (Section 54).

lastAuthenticatedAt.description: Section 15 (PLT-008): when the credential last authenticated successfully, as recorded by Platform Access (debounced: may lag real use by up to 5 minutes); null when never seen since last-use tracking began.

expiringSoon.description: Section 15 (PLT-008): true when the credential stops authenticating (expiry, or the end of its rotation overlap) within 14 days — rotate it now. Null only from an older identity authority.

platform-developer.control.v1.Credential.description: Section 54: metadata of a Platform Access API credential. Never a secret or verifier.

platform-developer.control.v1.DirectoryA.description: ADR 0065: a PUBLISHED, PUBLIC app of the directory (its published manifest).

meetingSurface.description: Whether the app has an in-meeting surface.

id.description: The Platform Access principal id (kind EXTERNAL_APPLICATION_PRINCIPAL).

platform-developer.control.v1.EndUser.description: ADR 0062: a partner user (a Platform Access principal of the credential's environment). DEACTIVATED: deleted (profile erased, id kept).

platform-developer.control.v1.EndUserLis.description: A page of partner users; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

subject.description: Internal reads with serviceAccountId / credentialId: the caller's own (never higher) limits and levels; the top-level values stay the environment's.

platform-developer.control.v1.Entitlemen.description: Effective platform entitlements (Section 54 §10.4 precedence: organization plan, explicit operator override, stricter project plan, environment cap, service-account and credential restrictions; the most restrictive value wins and the limiting level is named). Internal reads also carry the versioned snapshot consuming services cache.

id.description: The canonical Platform Access environment id.

authorityStatus.description: Status reported by Platform Access (GET of one environment).

platform-developer.control.v1.Environmen.description: Section 55: effective limits, current usage and remaining allowance where meaningful, and limit warnings.
A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

serviceAccountJson.description: The Firebase service-account key JSON (type service_account; its project_id, when present, must equal projectId). Write-only.

platform-developer.control.v1.Invitation.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

token.description: One-time acceptance token, returned ONLY in this response (stored as a digest; never readable again).

secret.description: The raw credential, shown exactly once (never on an idempotent replay).

secretRedacted.description: Present on an idempotent replay instead of the secret.

platform-developer.control.v1.IssuedCred.description: Section 54: an issued or rotated credential; the secret is returned once only.

userId.description: Opaque CF Meet account id (human developer); not a Platform Access principal.

platform-developer.control.v1.MemberList.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

platform-developer.control.v1.OAuthRevok.description: RFC 7009 revocation request (application/x-www-form-urlencoded; same client authentication as the token endpoint).

platform-developer.control.v1.OAuthToken.description: RFC 6749 token response (snake_case). bot_token only on the first authorization-code exchange of an ORGANIZATION install with bot scopes.

RFC 6749 token request (application/x-www-form-urlencoded). Client authentication: HTTP Basic (client_secret_basic) or client_id + client_secret in the body (client_secret_post), never both. PKCE (code_verifier, S256) is mandatory for authorization_code.

platform-developer.control.v1.OAuthUseri.description: The signed-in user's profile for an app: sub is pairwise per app; email only with profile:email.

id.description: The organization id IS the canonical Platform Access tenant id.

classification.description: Platform Access tenant classification (operator-controlled; GET of one organization only).

platform-developer.control.v1.Organizati.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

platform-developer.control.v1.PlanAssign.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

platform-developer.control.v1.Production.description: Section 55 production-access request: SANDBOX_READY → PRODUCTION_REQUESTED → UNDER_REVIEW → APPROVED / REJECTED → LIVE / SUSPENDED.

id.description: The project id IS the canonical Platform Access application id.

platform-developer.control.v1.ProjectLis.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

scopes.description: Platform Access application scope grants (Platform Access is the authority).

platform-developer.control.v1.PushCreden.description: ADR 0063: push credential METADATA. The secret (APNs .p8 key / FCM service-account JSON) is sealed to the Notification Service on receipt and never stored, logged or returned.

platform-developer.control.v1.PutAllowed.description: The complete list (replaces it): exact `scheme://host[:port]`, lowercase host, no path, no wildcard, no explicit default port; https only, except http://localhost and http://127.0.0.1 in SANDBOX / TEST.

platform-developer.control.v1.PutAppRequ.description: PUT /v1/projects/{projectId}/app: the manifest (http://localhost redirect URIs only while DRAFT; at least one user or bot scope; event types from the install-routable families).

platform-developer.control.v1.PutAppTest.description: ADR 0064: the draft test accounts (CF Meet account ids, format checked only, at most 25).

tokensNotBefore.description: Tokens issued before this instant (and every device credential derived from them) no longer work.

platform-developer.control.v1.Role.description: Part VI workspace role (Section 50 permission matrix).

platform-developer.control.v1.ServiceAcc.description: A Platform Access service account (machine identity) of one environment, read through the Developer Platform. Platform Access is its only store; API credentials (secrets) are never part of it (Section 54).

id.description: The canonical Platform Access service account id.

name.description: Stable key, unique within the environment.

platform-developer.control.v1.ServiceAcc.description: A page of results; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page (null: last page).

Platform Access service-account status. The Developer Platform suspends / resumes (ACTIVE ⇄ SUSPENDED); REVOKED is terminal and an operator decision. A non-ACTIVE service account's API credentials do not authenticate.

platform-developer.control.v1.SupportPro.description: Section 57 support / incident routing metadata: member references only, no ticket content, emails or phone numbers.

platform-developer.control.v1.UpdateEndU.description: Profile changes (`null` clears) and suspension / reactivation; deletion is DELETE.

externalId.description: The partner's opaque user id (printable ASCII, no spaces); never a phone number, tel: / sip: URI.

platform-developer.control.v1.UpsertUser.description: Creates the user if new (idempotent on externalId), then mints a token.

platform-developer.control.v1.UsageFactV.description: One immutable usage fact: safe resource reference and public dimensions only (no provider ids, rates or content).

platform-developer.control.v1.UsageSumma.description: Section 55: environment-scoped daily usage rollups and period totals (billing-neutral quantities).

token.description: The CF Meet user token, shown ONCE (`Authorization: Bearer cfut_…` on the device).

tokenRedacted.description: An Idempotency-Key replay: the token is never returned again.

msg.description: Chat: needs `messages.read` / `messages.send` on the minting credential.

mtg.description: Meetings the user may join, with a role: needs `meetings.write`. The token's compact `{c, r}` form is accepted too.

platform-developer.control.v1.UserTokenG.description: ADR 0062 user token grants; effective grants are re-intersected with the minting credential's CURRENT scopes on every verification.

token.description: The CF Meet user token, shown ONCE (`Authorization: Bearer cfut_…` on the device).

platform-developer.webhooks.v1.ConsoleWe.description: The Developer Console view: the customer view plus environment, origin and endpoint health (never the signing secret).

origin.description: NATIVE, or migrated from Calling's legacy webhook store (id preserved).

signingSecret.description: Returned ONLY by create and rotate-secret; absent from an Idempotency-Key replay of a create (never stored).

url.description: Public https endpoint. Server-side validation additionally refuses every loopback / private / link-local / CGNAT / metadata address and re-checks the resolved address at connection time (DNS rebinding); redirects are never followed.

platform-developer.webhooks.v1.DeliveryS.description: FAILED is the dead letter (replayable). SHADOW: recorded while the platform ran in shadow mode before the cut-over; deliberately not sent.

disabledReason.description: CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES: disabled automatically; re-enabling resets the health.

url.description: Public https endpoint. Server-side validation additionally refuses every loopback / private / link-local / CGNAT / metadata address and re-checks the resolved address at connection time (DNS rebinding); redirects are never followed.

platform-developer.webhooks.v1.WebhookAt.description: One delivery attempt: status class and bounded error class only (never a response body).

platform-developer.webhooks.v1.WebhookEv.description: The public event catalog: Calling, Privacy Relay, SMS Gateway and Messaging families (Part G §68, unchanged) plus the Section 53 meeting, participant, artifact, number, credential and production-access families. ADR 0064 install events: app.installed / app.uninstalled / app.grant_revoked (the installed app's own lifecycle) and bot.message_received / bot.mentioned (Messaging, ids only, never message text); events routed to an installed app carry data.installationId.

platform.common.v1.ApplicationEnvironmen.description: Kind of a customer application environment (Part B section 7).

platform.common.v1.RequestId.description: Server-generated identifier of one request / one service hop.
